about_the_game:
Join Santa’s cheerful elf in this heartwarming holiday game where your mission is to catch as many falling gifts as possible! It’s Christmas time, and every present you grab brings joy to children around the world. Help the elf fill Santa’s sack by collecting gifts raining down from the sky—just be quick, accurate, and ready for the challenge!

The more gifts you catch, the higher your score will climb. Try to beat your personal best and set a new holiday high score! But stay sharp—missing too many presents could cost you valuable points.

Immerse yourself in the magic of the season with a joyful Christmas-themed soundtrack and a cozy, wintery atmosphere filled with snowflakes, twinkling lights, and holiday cheer. Whether you're in the mood for a quick festive break or a full-on gift-catching marathon, this game brings the spirit of Christmas right to your screen.

Controls:

Use your mouse to catch gifts.
